title: DAC Testbench
text: Measure DC and AC performance metrics of DAC output, 1 input, 2 outputs; {Measurement} selects whether to measure DC or AC performance metrics, {Recommended min. simulation stop time (s)} sets the minimum time simulation must run for meaningful result, {Set as model stop time} sets the automatically set recommended min. simulation stop time as model stop time, {Endpoint} sets the measure DNL, INL using endpoint method, {Best fit} sets the measure DNL, INL using best fit method, {Plot DC analysis result}, {Export measurement result} sets the store detailed test results to base workspace, {Digital input frequency (Hz)} sets the frequency of digital input signal to DAC, {Start conversion frequency (Hz)} sets the frequency of internal start-conversion clock, {Error tolerance (LSB)} sets the maximum difference between successive samples of digital, {Autofill setup parameters} sets the automatically propagate setup parameters from DAC, {Number of bits}, {Input polarity} sets the polarity of input signal, {Reference (V)} sets the reference voltage, {Bias (V)} sets the bias voltage added to output, {Settling time (s)} sets the time required for output to settle, {Settling time tolerance (LSB)} sets the tolerance for calculating settling time, {Hold off time (s)} sets the delay before measurement analysis, {Show spectrum analyzer during simulation} sets the displays Spectrum Analyzer during, {Autofill target metric} sets the automatically propagate target metrics from DAC, {Offset error} sets the shifts quantization steps by specific value and {Gain error} sets the error in slope of DAC transfer curve. Values come from the instance.
